measurement_note: Size is n, the array length. The legal 10-, 20-, and 40-element tiers span 4x and contain only ones, so every legally spaced quadruple matches. The accepted sweep inserts each left pair exactly once and performs quadratic work. A correct slower baseline rebuilds all eligible left-pair frequencies for every third index, repeating pair work cubically.
